fact: The DGI working paper says SYC@D, launched on 29 December 2021, and SIEBI are not yet deployed on DGI servers, and that eCADASTRE, migrating from SIEBI, is in production works and could be used during 2022.

The PARGFM land-component coordinator told leFaso.net that development and deployment of a national land information system is in progress, with land services of 20 communes interconnected ahead of it.

The Prime Minister launched the SYC@D land and cadastre system on 21 March 2025; the tax director general said the processes implemented let users request, process and receive online a cadastral extract, land allocation certificate and provisional and final transfer orders.
The tax director general said on 21 March 2025 that the cadastral and geographic databases have been integrated into SYC@D.
